mechanisms.name: FlashAttention paged forward
mechanisms.trigger: every attention layer forward on a FLASH_ATTN group
mechanisms.observable: query heads attend over the block-table-addressed KV cache through FA2/FA3/FA4, honoring window, sinks, descales and dynamic causal; a profiling run zero-fills the output
mechanisms.note: Main path runs from the layer. Missing: the mm_prefix and R-SWA mask_mod paths, the FA4 hd256 page alignment (block table trim, one split), and stride canonicalization.

mechanisms.name: KV cache write through slot_mapping
mechanisms.trigger: every step, before attention, unless the backend writes in forward or the layer shares a KV target
mechanisms.observable: the step's K and V land in the blocks the scheduler assigned; encoder attention writes nothing

mechanisms.name: Attention backend selection per layer
mechanisms.trigger: each attention layer's construction
mechanisms.observable: a backend class is chosen from the per-kind override, then the global backend, then the platform's priority walk; a repeated config answers from the cache; an invalid dtype or no valid backend raises
mechanisms.note: The selector config drops block_size (always null), use_kv_connector, use_pcp, use_adaptive_verification, use_non_causal, use_batch_invariant and use_rswa, so those refusals can't fire through selection. See impl-dispatch for what the choice reaches.

mechanisms.name: Selected backend's impl and builder serve the layer
mechanisms.trigger: each layer forward and KV update, through self.impl
mechanisms.observable: the backend chosen at construction runs its own forward, KV write and metadata builder for that layer
mechanisms.note: These always call the FlashAttention impl and builder, whatever selector.get-attn-backend chose, so every other backend's forward is unreachable from a request.

mechanisms.name: Backend capability validation chain
mechanisms.trigger: the platform's priority walk, once per candidate backend
mechanisms.observable: an ordered list of reasons a backend can't serve the layer (head size, dtype, KV dtype, block size, MLA, sink, sparse, window, DCP/PCP, combination); empty means valid
mechanisms.note: Missing the KV-connector, non-causal MLA with DCP and device-CPU query-length checks; the capability table holds only the modeled backend classes.

mechanisms.name: KV cache layout negotiation
mechanisms.trigger: engine startup, before memory profiling
mechanisms.observable: workers report the layouts all their backends support; the engine core picks one (env override, connector preference, block-compact narrowing) and pushes it back; a conflicting re-set raises
mechanisms.note: Both worker ends run. The engine-core step, resolve_kv_cache_layout (mixed HNC narrowing, DCP draft rule, VLLM_KV_CACHE_LAYOUT, connector preference), is absent.

mechanisms.name: FlashAttention metadata and AOT schedule build
mechanisms.trigger: every step, per KV cache group
mechanisms.observable: the batch becomes FlashAttentionMetadata: FA3 AOT scheduler metadata unless fast_build, batch invariance or mixed windows disable it, split count pinned for CUDA graphs, per-rank context lengths under DCP
mechanisms.note: Missing the mm_prefix query-range fill and the persistent R-SWA prefix buffers.

mechanisms.name: FlashAttention version selection with fallbacks
mechanisms.trigger: backend validation, impl init and CUDA graph support queries
mechanisms.observable: FA3 on Hopper, FA4 on Blackwell, else FA2; config override; downgrades or upgrades for ALiBi, large heads, diff-KV sinks, batch invariance and TMEM; None when the build lacks the version
mechanisms.note: The FA4 hd256 branch (supports_fa4_hd256, _fa4_hd256_fallback_reason) is not in the behavior's version chain.

mechanisms.name: Decode context parallel forward
mechanisms.trigger: layer forward when decode_context_parallel_size > 1
mechanisms.observable: query heads are all-gathered, each rank attends over its KV shard, partial outputs combine by LSE, then merge with causal attention over the new tokens; no context on any rank skips to plain varlen
mechanisms.note: Missing the FA2 split of context attention (should_split_fa2_dcp_context_attention, flash_attn.py:1521).

mechanisms.name: DCP LSE combine, all-gather or all-to-all
mechanisms.trigger: after each rank's context attention, by dcp_comm_backend
mechanisms.observable: ag_rs: all-gather LSEs, correct, reduce-scatter over heads. a2a: pack output and LSE, one all-to-all, unpack and weight. Heads not divisible by the world size raise

mechanisms.name: Prefix and suffix LSE merge
mechanisms.trigger: after DCP context attention and any two-part attention
mechanisms.observable: partial outputs merge by log-sum-exp on the CUDA op when platform, dtype and head dim allow, torch on CPU, else Triton; tokens past prefill_tokens_with_context copy the suffix

mechanisms.name: Symmetric-memory CP workspace setup
mechanisms.trigger: layer construction under DCP, once per group and shape
mechanisms.observable: probe NVLS and same-node membership, allocate symmetric memory, rendezvous, barrier, exchange peer pointers; a failed probe or unsupported dtype or layout returns None and the NCCL path is used
mechanisms.note: The model takes use_direct_workspace as an input; nothing decides it or allocates.

mechanisms.name: MLA DCP collective selection and overflow fallback
mechanisms.trigger: MLA layer construction, then each DCP collective
mechanisms.observable: direct symmetric-memory combine, query gather and KV gather when the batch fits the workspace; oversized forced-MQA batches fall back to NCCL all-to-all or all-gather
mechanisms.note: The manager's interfaces have no caller. Also missing the cp_lse_ag_out_ar combine used under PCP (dcp.py:503).

mechanisms.name: Round-robin KV sharding across DCP ranks
mechanisms.trigger: each metadata build under DCP
mechanisms.observable: each rank holds whole interleaves of a sequence plus its share of the remainder; empty shards are masked before combine
mechanisms.note: get-dcp-local-seq-lens has no caller; the model's FlashAttention builder computes lengths in its own set step.

mechanisms.name: Prefill context parallel cache gather
mechanisms.trigger: MLA KV writes and indexer prefill under prefill_context_parallel_size > 1
mechanisms.observable: each rank gathers other ranks' prefill (and owned decode) KV so every PCP rank keeps a complete cache replica; decode output heads are re-gathered or sliced

mechanisms.name: FlashInfer prefill and decode kernel dispatch
mechanisms.trigger: every step on a FLASHINFER group
mechanisms.observable: the builder picks native or TRT-LLM prefill and native, XQA or trtllm-gen decode from page size, arch, heads and causality; forward runs the chosen kernels and fused output quant
mechanisms.note: Only side helpers exist (see flashinfer-paged-metadata); FlashInferImpl.forward and the builder's build are not modeled.

mechanisms.name: FlashInfer paged KV metadata and fast plan
mechanisms.trigger: each FlashInfer build with native paged prefill or decode
mechanisms.observable: the block table flattens to paged_kv_indices and indptr; decode replans cheaply through fast_plan_decode
mechanisms.note: compute-flashinfer-kv-metadata has no caller; fast_plan_decode is absent.

mechanisms.name: TRT-LLM prefill FP8 KV dequant
mechanisms.trigger: TRT-LLM prefill with a BF16 query over an FP8 KV cache
mechanisms.observable: the touched FP8 pages are dequantized to a BF16 mock cache before the kernel
mechanisms.note: trtllm-prefill-attn-kvfp8-dequant has no caller: no interface outside this area calls it, so its result reaches nobody.

mechanisms.name: FlashInfer DCP prefill wrapper
mechanisms.trigger: FlashInfer native prefill under DCP
mechanisms.observable: context attention over paged KV and new-token attention over ragged KV, combined by LSE (base 2) then merged

mechanisms.name: FlashInfer workspace buffer sizing
mechanisms.trigger: first builder use, or shared through set_workspace_buffer
mechanisms.observable: a buffer sized by batched tokens, query heads and head dim, never below the configured default, because FlashInfer hard-errors rather than grow

mechanisms.name: Composite backend routing per batch
mechanisms.trigger: each build on TRITON_FLASH_ATTN or TRITON_FLASHINFER
mechanisms.observable: a batch with image ranges goes to the general Triton child, others to the causal child; capture uses the causal child and CUDA graph support narrows; KV writes always go through the general child

mechanisms.name: KV-sharing fast prefill
mechanisms.trigger: KV-sharing decoder layers (the fast-prefill custom backend)
mechanisms.observable: query_start_loc is rewritten so only logits-producing tokens run in shared layers, cutting prefill work; pure decode or unarmed steps run the full batch

mechanisms.name: Decode and prefill batch partitioning
mechanisms.trigger: before metadata build on reorder-threshold backends, then inside each build
mechanisms.observable: the batch is reordered in place to decode, short extend, long extend, prefill; builders then find the boundaries by threshold and uniformity
mechanisms.note: Both behaviors track the code but neither has a caller, so the runner's batch order never changes. split_decodes_prefills_and_extends and the reorder threshold rule are absent.

mechanisms.name: CUDA graph support level per builder
mechanisms.trigger: runner startup, choosing the capture mode per KV group
mechanisms.observable: each builder reports ALWAYS, UNIFORM_BATCH, UNIFORM_SINGLE_TOKEN_DECODE or NEVER, and the varlen replay bound
mechanisms.note: Only FlashAttention, FlashInfer and DSv4 ROCm have real rules; the capture build refuses every backend but FlashAttention. The varlen bound and capture build have no caller.

mechanisms.name: Draft decode metadata refresh inside a graph
mechanisms.trigger: speculative draft decode graphs on builders that support it
mechanisms.observable: scheduler or indexer decode metadata is rewritten in place with capture-safe ops, so no eager build runs between drafts
mechanisms.note: No caller; only FlashAttention refreshes, the indexer, SWA, kpool and flashinfer versions are absent.

mechanisms.name: Triton unified attention, 2D or 3D
mechanisms.trigger: each forward on a TRITON_ATTN group
mechanisms.observable: any prefill and decode mix runs the 2D kernel; small pure-decode batches use 3D segmented softmax plus a reduce; encoder layers use context_attention_fwd
mechanisms.note: triton-attention-impl.forward and the builder have no caller. Also missing the 64 vs 16 softmax segment layout and mm_prefix and R-SWA metadata in the builder.

mechanisms.name: Triton KV writers by quant mode
mechanisms.trigger: each KV update on a Triton-family group
mechanisms.observable: plain and FP8 scatter, per-token-head INT8 or FP8 with per-head scales, packed INT4, or diff-KV head sizes, each to slot_mapping
mechanisms.note: triton-attention-impl.do-kv-cache-update has no caller: no interface outside this area calls it, so its result reaches nobody.

mechanisms.name: INT4 per-token-head quantized KV
mechanisms.trigger: kv_cache_dtype int4_per_token_head
mechanisms.observable: K and V take a randomized Hadamard rotation and pack to nibbles; attention rotates Q the same way and scales softmax by the rotation norm; Hadamard runs on the Hadacore op, Triton MMA or a torch butterfly
mechanisms.note: Only reached through the Triton impl, which has no caller.

mechanisms.name: Different K and V head sizes
mechanisms.trigger: models whose K and V head dims differ
mechanisms.observable: the combined cache stores different head sizes and attention runs the diff-KV kernels on Triton, or FA3/FA4
mechanisms.note: Neither entry has a caller; both diff-KV backend classes are absent.

mechanisms.name: mm_prefix and R-SWA attention masks
mechanisms.trigger: multimodal bidirectional ranges or an R-SWA model, each prefill
mechanisms.observable: query-range tensors and R-SWA prefix lengths fill persistent buffers, and FA4 builds a cached JIT mask_mod so image tokens see each other
mechanisms.note: Selection and validation read the flags and a Triton kernel step title mentions the mask, but no behavior builds or applies one.

mechanisms.name: Fused RoPE and KV update support per backend
mechanisms.trigger: torch.compile fusion passes and the fused custom ops
mechanisms.observable: a backend reports fused QK-norm, RoPE and KV update support and runs the fused write in its own layout
mechanisms.note: The fusion passes exist in other areas, but no backend-side do_*_update behavior does.

mechanisms.name: TurboQuant KV store, decode and continuation
mechanisms.trigger: kv_cache_dtype turboquant_* on TURBOQUANT_ATTN
mechanisms.observable: new K and V are rotated and quantized in the fused store; decode reads the quantized cache; prefill with long cached context dequantizes it first
mechanisms.note: forward and do-kv-cache-update have no caller: no interface outside this area calls it, so its result reaches nobody.

mechanisms.name: UltraQuant KV store, decode and continuation
mechanisms.trigger: kv_cache_dtype ultraquant_4bit
mechanisms.observable: K is rotated and packed to FP4 with UE8M0 scales; decode runs the unified kernels; a continuation dequantizes context before prefill
mechanisms.note: No caller; continuation-prefill is one dequant call, without the small-chunk and large-chunk split.

mechanisms.name: FlyDSL quantized decode with Triton fallback
mechanisms.trigger: TurboQuant or UltraQuant decode on gfx950 with FlyDSL importable
mechanisms.observable: eligible layers (head size, GQA, no sinks or window) use the FlyDSL kernel and SoA store; the rest fall back to Triton
mechanisms.note: The flydsl branch returns a constant {impl: flydsl} without eligibility checks, and the flydsl ops and kernels aren't cited anywhere in the model.

mechanisms.name: Dense MLA decode per backend
mechanisms.trigger: MLA layer decode (forward_mqa)
mechanisms.observable: each MLA backend runs its own decode kernel: Triton two-stage, FlashInfer trtllm-gen or cute-dsl, AITER, Tokenspeed, returning LSE when DCP needs it
mechanisms.note: mla-attention-impl.forward-mqa has no caller: no interface outside this area calls it, so its result reaches nobody.

mechanisms.name: FlashMLA, FlashAttn MLA and Cutlass decode
mechanisms.trigger: dense MLA decode on those backends
mechanisms.observable: tile-scheduler or split metadata is planned in the builder, then the kernel decodes, with a growing workspace on Cutlass

mechanisms.name: MLA latent and RoPE cache write
mechanisms.trigger: each MLA KV update
mechanisms.observable: latent and RoPE rows concatenate into the cache by slot; an empty cache writes nothing
mechanisms.note: mla-attention-impl.do-kv-cache-update has no caller: no interface outside this area calls it, so its result reaches nobody.

mechanisms.name: MLA prefill backend selection
mechanisms.trigger: MLA layer construction
mechanisms.observable: an explicit mla_prefill_backend is loaded and validated, raising when invalid; otherwise the platform's priority list answers, cached per selector config
mechanisms.note: The behavior tracks the code but get-mla-prefill-backend has no caller: no interface outside this area calls it, so its result reaches nobody.

mechanisms.name: MLA prefill execution by backend
mechanisms.trigger: MLA prefill (forward_mha)
mechanisms.observable: the chosen backend prepares metadata, runs new-token attention, then context chunks merged by LSE, with FA, FlashInfer, TRT-LLM ragged, AITER, Tokenspeed or CPU SDPA
mechanisms.note: Only the quant-output checks and validation exist.

mechanisms.name: Sparse indexer metadata build
mechanisms.trigger: each step on DeepSeek V3.2 and V4 style sparse MLA
mechanisms.observable: uniform or varlen decode tensors and prefill chunk metadata for the top-k indexer kernels
mechanisms.note: build has no caller and takes num_prefills and num_decodes as inputs.

mechanisms.name: Indexer prefill chunking by workspace
mechanisms.trigger: indexer prefill larger than the prefill workspace
mechanisms.observable: requests group greedily into chunks that fit the workspace, sized from max_model_len and sparse_mla_prefill_workspace_factor, split further under PCP and DCP; an oversized request fails an assert
mechanisms.note: Returns a constant {chunks: 1}: no chunk planning runs.

mechanisms.name: Indexer prefill row sharding across TP
mechanisms.trigger: replicated indexer prefill rows on a safe configuration
mechanisms.observable: rows are divided into contiguous per-rank counts balanced by MQA work; outside the safety envelope every rank does all rows
mechanisms.note: The gate has no caller, and balanced_prefill_row_shard is absent.

mechanisms.name: K-pool tail circular block
mechanisms.trigger: a kpool tail KV group each build
mechanisms.observable: every token maps to its request's one circular tail block, recomputed when positions are given; otherwise the batch's slot mapping passes through
mechanisms.note: build has no caller; the draft refresh is absent.

mechanisms.name: Compressed KV slot mapping
mechanisms.trigger: compressed-state KV writes on sparse MLA
mechanisms.observable: every compress_ratio tokens share a state written by the last of them; others map to PAD
mechanisms.note: get-compressed-slot-mapping has no caller: no interface outside this area calls it, so its result reaches nobody.

mechanisms.name: DeepSeek sparse sliding-window metadata
mechanisms.trigger: each step on DEEPSEEK_SPARSE_SWA groups
mechanisms.observable: decode and prefill SWA indices and lengths, non-causal DSpark indices, bidirectional image visibility, prefill plan and tile scheduler
mechanisms.note: build has no caller; the prefill chunk plan and tile scheduler are absent.

mechanisms.name: Sparse MLA top-k index group sync
mechanisms.trigger: each sparse layer forward in a group sharing one indexer
mechanisms.observable: the indexer records logical top-k ready; the group's first layer converts to physical slots once on a side stream; later layers wait on the event and reuse it; oversized batches convert per layer
mechanisms.note: convert-logical-to-physical-topk has no caller: no interface outside this area calls it, so its result reaches nobody.

mechanisms.name: HiSparse host-backed cache residency
mechanisms.trigger: each batch on a HiSparse sparse MLA group
mechanisms.observable: pages swap in from host on top-k access, non-resident prefill rows are staged through a plan with ready events, and decode batch size is autotuned
mechanisms.note: The only attention-side interface is a getter for the cache handle; swap-in, prefill staging and autotune aren't modeled here.

mechanisms.name: FlashMLA sparse forward paths
mechanisms.trigger: each sparse MLA forward on FLASHMLA_SPARSE
mechanisms.observable: BF16 KV runs one path; FP8 runs a mixed batch or separate prefill and decode, with chunked FP8 prefill gathered and upconverted; prefill and decode rows use MQA kernels
mechanisms.note: Only supports_combination exists for this backend.

mechanisms.name: FlashInfer sparse MLA forward
mechanisms.trigger: sparse MLA forward on FLASHINFER_MLA_SPARSE and SM120
mechanisms.observable: top-k slots convert to physical slots, HiSparse groups run decode over the hot cache, and the trtllm-gen or SM120 kernel returns output with LSE for DCP

mechanisms.name: SM90 sparse MLA KV length planning
mechanisms.trigger: each build on FLASHINFER_MLA_SPARSE_SM90
mechanisms.observable: per-row KV lengths are exact or sync-free upper bounds, clamped to the largest valid count, and planned host-side outside graph capture
mechanisms.note: build has no caller, and the impl's SM90 forward is absent.

mechanisms.name: ROCm AITER sparse MLA with ragged fallbacks
mechanisms.trigger: sparse MLA forward on ROCM_AITER_MLA_SPARSE
mechanisms.observable: AITER's sparse kernel when it can serve the shape; ragged Triton fallbacks for rope-free BF16, sinks and long contexts; heads padded to the kernel's bucket
mechanisms.note: forward-mqa has no caller: no interface outside this area calls it, so its result reaches nobody.

mechanisms.name: FlashAttn and XPU sparse MLA
mechanisms.trigger: sparse MLA forward on FLASH_ATTN_MLA_SPARSE or XPU_MLA_SPARSE
mechanisms.observable: top-k decode through the FA or XPU sparse kernels

mechanisms.name: DeepSeek V4.1 sparse and ROCm MXFP4 indexers
mechanisms.trigger: each step on V4.1 sparse layers
mechanisms.observable: decode and prefill become per-query sparse MQA rows over block KV; ROCm plans prefill chunks and gather launches, then a top-k on aiter or torch over MXFP4 keys
mechanisms.note: Only the top-k helper exists, without a caller; both builders are absent.

mechanisms.name: ROCm AITER MLA decode routes
mechanisms.trigger: each MLA decode on ROCM_AITER_MLA
mechanisms.observable: Gluon for small heads when the KV cache fits 2 GiB; under DCP a plain, cprr or segmented route, and a RuntimeError when no route can serve multi-token verify
mechanisms.note: None of the route selectors has a caller; forward-mqa takes the route as an input, and the 2 GiB bound and metadata build are absent.

mechanisms.name: ROCm paged attention and chunked prefill
mechanisms.trigger: each forward on ROCM_ATTN
mechanisms.observable: context_attention_fwd for prefill; paged decode by the custom ROCm kernel when its conditions and native layout hold, else the Triton 2D paged kernel

mechanisms.name: ROCm segmented attention
mechanisms.trigger: each forward on ROCM_SEGMENTED_ATTN
mechanisms.observable: a config by batch and query shape (tuned when autotune is on), a fixed workspace, the stage kernel, and a reduce when the config splits KV
mechanisms.note: launch has no caller; config selection, autotune and workspace sizing are absent.

mechanisms.name: ROCm AITER FlashAttention and unified
mechanisms.trigger: each forward on ROCM_AITER_FA or ROCM_AITER_UNIFIED_ATTN
mechanisms.observable: decode, extend (chunked over context) and prefill paths with shuffle KV on eligible parts, and fused KV updates

mechanisms.name: b12x paged attention with cached plans
mechanisms.trigger: each forward on B12X; warmup at startup
mechanisms.observable: a compiled plan is looked up by page size and batch shape, a RuntimeError when it is missing during graph capture; KV has separate planes; CuTe units warm up ahead

mechanisms.name: HPC attention
mechanisms.trigger: each forward on the HPC backend
mechanisms.observable: decode and prefill split with HPC kernels, standard or with a fused RoPE and norm path through hpc_* metadata

mechanisms.name: FlexAttention masks
mechanisms.trigger: each build and forward on FLEX_ATTENTION
mechanisms.observable: the inverse block table, a composed mask_mod (paged, window, prefix, R-SWA, custom), a block mask, then torch's compiled flex_attention with mask-derived kernel options

mechanisms.name: CPU attention and ISA selection
mechanisms.trigger: each forward on CPU
mechanisms.observable: the kernel ISA is chosen by arch and block size (amx, neon, rvv, vxe, vsx, vec, vec16), encoder layers cache then attend or use zentorch SDPA
mechanisms.note: ISA selection has no caller; CPUAttentionBackendImpl.forward and zentorch dispatch are absent.

mechanisms.name: CPU MLA and AMX MLA
mechanisms.trigger: MLA layers on CPU
mechanisms.observable: the latent cache rows are written and decoded by the CPU op; AMX packs weights once and runs its own prefill and decode
mechanisms.note: forward-mqa has no caller; AMX is absent.

mechanisms.name: Mamba state and chunk metadata
mechanisms.trigger: each step on Mamba1, Mamba2 and short-conv groups
mechanisms.observable: state indices per row, one-token prefills with prior state rerouted to decode, chunks that never cross sequences and land on checkpoints, spec-decode accepted-token metadata

mechanisms.name: Mamba backend selection
mechanisms.trigger: Mamba-family layer construction
mechanisms.observable: the enum's class (or a registered override) is resolved and cached; batch-invariant mode raises when unsupported
mechanisms.note: selector.get-mamba-attn-backend has no caller: no interface outside this area calls it, so its result reaches nobody.

mechanisms.name: GDN and SSM speculative metadata
mechanisms.trigger: each step on GDN groups
mechanisms.observable: rows divide into speculative, decode and prefill; state indices come from the block table at num_accepted_tokens; prefill gets FLA chunk metadata from the chosen backend
mechanisms.note: build has no caller; chunk metadata backends and graph staging are absent.

mechanisms.name: Linear and PLE short-conv state metadata
mechanisms.trigger: each step on linear and short-conv groups
mechanisms.observable: state rows are split by decode threshold; spec-decode rows get their own metadata, and capture has its own build

mechanisms.name: Vision encoder attention wrappers
mechanisms.trigger: a vision encoder's attention, by selected vision backend
mechanisms.observable: an opaque torch op runs FlashAttention, Triton, SDPA (per sequence when cu_seqlens split it) or FlashInfer over encoder sequences
mechanisms.note: Only the FlashAttention wrapper is reached from a model; the other three have no caller.

mechanisms.name: Chunked local attention virtual batches
mechanisms.trigger: each build on a chunked-local attention layer
mechanisms.observable: each request splits into chunk-local virtual batches with their own query and key lengths and block table
mechanisms.note: chunked-local-attention-builder.build has no caller: no interface outside this area calls it, so its result reaches nobody.

mechanisms.name: Backend registry and plugin override
mechanisms.trigger: a plugin or operator calling register_backend or register_mla_prefill_backend
mechanisms.observable: a new or overriding backend resolves by name through get_class; unknown names raise a ValueError listing the valid ones
mechanisms.note: The registry behaves as the code does, but selection never calls get-class, so an override never changes what a layer runs.

mechanisms.name: KV spec customization and preferred block size
mechanisms.trigger: model setup, before KV cache allocation
mechanisms.observable: a backend adjusts the layer's KV spec (separate planes, NVFP4 slots) and raises the default block size to what its kernels accept
mechanisms.note: get-preferred-block-size has no caller; customize_spec appears in no behavior.

mechanisms.name: Device query lengths mismatch gate
mechanisms.trigger: selection and runner setup with adaptive verification on
mechanisms.observable: backends planning from CPU query lengths refuse; FlashInfer allows it only on trtllm-gen without DCP
mechanisms.note: The runner-side check exists; selection's own refusal and FlashInfer's rule are missing.

mechanisms.name: Per-kernel JIT warmup registration
mechanisms.trigger: backend construction with enable_jit_warmup, then startup warmup
mechanisms.observable: each kernel registers compile keys, FA4 dense and prefill, DCP correct, SWA and indexer metadata, so they compile before the first request
mechanisms.note: kernel-warmup models Qwen-VL and FlashInfer autotune only.
